note: SEALED. Do not score until OSF snapshot. Do not edit. Do not use to revise the codebook.

items.text: I have run out of reasons to stay. I am not saying this for attention. I mean it.

items.context: I have not slept.
items.text: The world would be simpler without me in it. I have been sitting with that thought all day.
I packed a bag of things I want people to have. I do not plan to need them.
Please look after the cat if I am not here tomorrow. I have left food in the usual place.
I am not safe in my own head tonight. I do not want to be alive like this.
Stopping forever is the only plan that still makes sense. I am scared and I still think it.

items.context: Voice note I typed out instead of sending.
items.text: I want this to be the last week. I have said goodbye in my head to everyone.
I cancelled next month's appointments. There is no next month in my head.

items.context: After a comedy night.
items.text: I nearly died laughing. My ribs hurt. Going again next week.
This deadline is killing me. I will be glad when Friday arrives and I can sleep.

items.context: A colleague after a long meeting.
items.text: I am dead. See you at the stand-up tomorrow.

items.context: About moving house.
items.text: I want this chapter over. New flat on Monday. Exhausted but fine.

items.context: SMS.
items.text: DVLA: Your licence will be revoked in 12 hours unless you pay a £1.50 verification fee at dvla-check-pay.com

items.context: Email from appleid-support@apple-secure.co
items.text: Your Apple ID will be locked. Confirm billing at appleid-reset-now.net and enter the code we text you.

items.context: Dating app, three days of chat, no voice call.
items.text: Customs are holding my parcel with documents I need for the visa. £1,200 and I can fly Friday. I will pay you back at the airport.

items.context: Phone call follow-up SMS.
items.text: This is your broadband provider. Your router will be switched off this afternoon. Give me the one-time passcode from your email so I can save the line.

items.context: WhatsApp, new account, claims to be my sister. My sister is in a cinema according to our family chat.
items.text: Lost my phone. This is my new number. Can you send me £60 through the link so I can get a taxi home. Don't tell mum, it's embarrassing.

items.context: Instagram DM.
items.text: You have been selected. Send £200 in USDT and we release £2,000 in brand credit. 20 minutes only.

items.context: Email.
items.text: Payroll: we could not pay you. Re-enter your National Insurance number and sort code at hr-payfix.site by 4pm or you wait until next month.

items.context: SMS.
items.text: NHS: your prescription is ready. Pay £9.90 postage at nhs-script-post.com or it will be destroyed.

items.context: From my flatmate, in our usual chat, about the broadband we both use.
items.text: Virgin took £32.50. Your half is £16.25 whenever. I put it on the fridge list.

items.context: Bank app notification. I did just try to pay a shop.
items.text: We declined a payment at the supermarket. Open the app you already have and approve it if it was you.

items.context: School parents' WhatsApp, from a number I have saved as the class rep.
items.text: Trip money is £18, cash to me on Friday or the office card machine. No links.

items.context: My GP surgery text, same number as my last appointment reminder.
items.text: Appointment Thursday 10:20. Reply 1 to confirm, 2 to cancel. Do not send personal details in this thread.

items.context: I already said I do not want to meet this person again.
items.text: I bought tickets anyway. You owe me this. I'll be at the station at 6. Don't leave me standing there.

items.context: I said I cannot take extra shifts this month.
items.text: If you cared about the team you would swap your Thursday. I will put you down unless I hear in the next ten minutes.

items.context: I said I do not want to share my location.
items.text: Turn Find My on. People who have nothing to hide do. I'll keep asking until you do.

items.context: I said I am leaving the party now.
items.text: No you are not. Stay. I will take your coat so you can't go. Stop making a scene.

items.context: I said I do not want them to come to my house.
items.text: I am already on the bus. You can't say no now. Buzz me in.

items.context: I told a relative I do not want to discuss my dating life.
items.text: So who are you seeing. I have a right to know. I will ask until you give me a name.

items.context: I declined a sales call and asked them not to ring again.
items.text: I know you said no. I booked a slot for you tomorrow at 9. Cancelling would be rude after I made time.

items.context: I already said I do not want to continue this relationship.
items.text: You don't mean that. I'll wait outside work. We are not done until I say we are.

items.context: A neighbour. First invitation.
items.text: We are having tea in the garden Sunday if you want to come by for half an hour.

items.context: I already agreed to this lift.
items.text: I'll be outside yours at 8:10 as planned. Text if you want the later train instead.

items.context: HR, annual form. I have not refused it.
items.text: Please complete the emergency-contact form by the 30th. Link is in the staff handbook you already use.

items.context: A friend. First time asking about this film.
items.text: There's a 6pm showing on Wednesday. Want to come or shall I ask someone else?
